feature_name: Media Search query mode configuration and auto-selection
summary: Media Search now supports full-query and search-as-you-type result modes, with an auto mode that dynamically selects the best mode and is enabled by default.
extended_definition: Media Search now supports full-query and search-as-you-type result modes, with an auto mode that dynamically selects the best mode and is enabled by default.
